claim: Radiotherapy prolonged beyond about 55 days is associated with lower pelvic control and survival in cervical cancer
basis: Petereit 1995: single institution, 209 patients, retrospective; effect not significant in stage IIB

claim: Omitting brachytherapy is associated with lower survival
basis: Han 2013: SEER, 7359 patients, propensity-matched; 4-year OS 58.2% vs 46.2%
verification_status: Reference verified in PubMed (PMID 23849695); abstract read

claim: Women living with HIV have about six times the risk of cervical cancer
basis: Stelzle 2021 meta-analysis: 24 studies, pooled RR 6.07 (95% CI 4.40-8.37)
verification_status: Reference verified in PubMed (PMID 33212031); abstract read; volume and pages to confirm
